fixture: Synthetic native1.6 2x2 board with opaque source IDs, a retained diagonal split and 7 on an indexless child; neighbor17, blue boundary and red vertex shading.
scope: Flick right from the 7 using desktop mouse or Chromium touch, preserve target ID and other numbers, native reload, one-step Undo/Redo. Units also cover repeated same direction, multiple angles in one undo group, duplicate indices, document/layer/topology replacement, pointercancel/multitouch, right-click deletion and constraint Direction/Auto. Other structural identity migrations and concave-direction geometry remain pending.
